C005-TS-156, the OpenCode row of C002-TS-219 restated, is carried to CHG-003 (Q-opencode-01; carry note in `.sdd/003-opencode-release/change.md`) and runs there with the OpenCode `@eval` scenarios that C002-DOD-002 moved; in CHG-005 it is closed by a DOD-G-01 waiver that P-01 decides at CHG-005's close

Every untagged scenario of `spec.md` § Acceptance (C005-TS-111, C005-TS-114 to C005-TS-119, C005-TS-122 to C005-TS-140, C005-TS-144 to C005-TS-150, C005-TS-166 to C005-TS-171, C005-TS-175) is an automated unit or integration test that carries its TS ID and passes in `npm run check` on the release commit
The line and branch coverage of the CLI source in the `npm run check` run of the release commit meets the thresholds of C001-NFR-502

On the release commit, the body of `plugins/architect/agents/sdd-conductor.md` has at most 64,000 characters and the body of every `SKILL.md` that holds the new-change procedure or the pre-phase round rule has at most 24,000 characters (constitution, NFR defaults, Skill size)
The link to the published 0.1.1 GitHub release is recorded, with P-01's review record of C005-TS-152
The output of `npm view architect-sdd@0.1.1 version` and `npm view architect-sdd time --json` is recorded with the publish time of the 0.1.1 GitHub release, and meets C005-TS-153

P-01's review record of C005-TS-154 and C005-TS-172 on the published 0.1.1 release notes shows present the old and the new `SDD.md` sentence and, for lite plans approved with the sdd CLI 0.1.0, the statement that the first `sdd stale check` of the sdd CLI 0.1.1 sets `20-plan` stale, that one revision and one G3 approval with the sdd CLI 0.1.1 make it approved again, and that this approval holds only while every later `sdd stale check` of the change runs the sdd CLI 0.1.1

The manual check of C005-NFR-001 is recorded per shell (PowerShell 7, Command Prompt, Git Bash) with the fixture tasks and the command order of its Method, each command, its exit code and the task or defect state afterwards, and reaches 5 of 5 in each shell

A record of one manual run per `@manual-vscode` scenario (C005-TS-155 with each of its 2 Examples rows, C005-TS-157, C005-TS-164, C005-TS-165) in Copilot VS Code, with the Copilot target package 0.1.1 built from the release commit, names the VS Code and GitHub Copilot Chat versions and the date, and for each scenario gives the `askQuestions` dialog shown (screenshot or chat export), P-01's answer, the content of the files its Then steps name and the result `passed`; C005-TS-164 and C005-TS-165 may share one run
